reason: A is the more plausible and directly testable intervention: dilute Ti could alter BCC bonding and dislocation barriers, and the composition series can determine whether ductility gains occur without unacceptable losses at 1600 °C or under irradiation. B assumes heat treatment alone can generate beneficial ordered precipitates in nominally single-phase NbMoTaW without establishing a thermodynamic ordering/decomposition tendency, largely repeats the cited inverted-BCC/B2 concept, and invokes TRIP despite its own evidence warning that it is unsuitable for inherently brittle RHEAs.
